findings.message: 'Last reviewed' is the publish date and the post is 46 days old; it reads as a template stamp, not a review.
The post has an affiliate link but no affiliate disclosure (FTC 16 CFR 255; site rule).
A first-hand testing or verification claim with no evidence block (who tested, when, what) in the post; add the evidence or rewrite it as sourced reporting.
'tagus hop' is given two different prices in the same post; keep one.
Internal link points to a page that is not in the ficha page list.

findings.quote: Belém Tower beside the Douro river
findings.why: Belém Tower stands on the Tagus (Tejo) river in Lisbon; the Douro is in Porto, so the place is misdescribed.

findings.quote: The Tagus Hop day pass costs €11, and the ferry is part of it, so the crossing costs nothing extra on that day.
findings.why: The text says €11 but the table says €9 for the same pass, so a reader could pay or budget wrongly.
findings.fix: Confirm the price on the linked tagus-hop.example source and use one consistent figure.

findings.quote: We tested every tram route and ferry timetable ourselves, so allow half a day here for the riverside walk.
findings.why: It claims first-hand testing of every route and timetable, but the post has no evidence section (e.g. How we tested) and the claim is implausible.
findings.fix: Remove the testing claim or add a real methodology section with evidence.

findings.why: The internal page slug does not match the site's page list (/blog/porto-weekend-guide), so the link is broken, and a Porto page does not support a Lisbon claim anyway.
findings.fix: Remove it or replace it with a relevant, valid Lisbon source.

findings.why: The price-check claim has no evidence and the two prices conflict, so the verification cannot be trusted; the Belém Combi Ticket €12 is also not covered by the visit-lisbon source in an identifiable way.
findings.fix: Verify the prices against tagus-hop.example/passes and cite the specific page next to each figure.

findings.why: The front matter says the post was updated 2026-10-20, so the review date is out of step with the update and the claimed October price check.
findings.fix: Update the review date to match the latest actual review.

findings.quote: walk the waterfront to the viewpoint near the Cristo Rei statue
findings.why: Cristo Rei is in Almada, a fair distance from Cacilhas, and is not an easy waterfront walk; the description may mislead.
findings.fix: Say that Cristo Rei is reached by bus or a longer uphill walk from Cacilhas, or name the nearer viewpoint.

findings.quote: Take the train or tram west to Belém.
findings.why: The Tagus Hop pass is described as covering shuttle routes, yet the post never says how it applies to Belém, and the Belém Combi Ticket is unexplained.
findings.fix: Clarify what the pass and the Combi Ticket include.
